Pricedown (vanilla GTA ammo typeface) notice
============================================

Ammo readouts in this HUD use Pricedown Black by Ray Larabie (Typodermic),
the typeface behind the Grand Theft Auto wordmark and the in-game HUD type.
cortex-hud is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games, Take-Two
Interactive, Ray Larabie, or Typodermic Fonts.

NO FONT FILE IS BUNDLED, by design. The free Typodermic Desktop license
forbids embedding the font in a game/app/website, converting or renaming
it, sharing it, and including it in open-source or publicly available
software. Serving it through NUI @font-face would be exactly such a use,
so the HUD only references a locally installed copy:

  local('Pricedown Black'), local('Pricedown Bl'), local('Pricedown')

To see the exact vanilla look, install Pricedown Black as a system font on
the PC that runs the game client (one install per player). Sources:

  https://typodermicfonts.com/pricedown (paid Web/Game license available)
  https://www.dafont.com/pricedown.font (free Desktop license)

Until Pricedown is installed locally, ammo falls back to Barlow Condensed
(bundled under OFL, see barlow-condensed-OFL.txt in this folder).
